changelog: The CSP-safe dynamic-style adapter now lives in a small autonomous runtime module, preserving the existing DOM, UX, translations and initialization order.
The new self-hosted asset is included by pkg, the signed build and the installer; no CDN or inline script was introduced.
changelog_es: El adaptador CSP para estilos dinámicos se separó de `app.js` en un módulo autónomo, conservando DOM, UX, i18n y orden de inicialización.
El nuevo asset viaja por pkg, build, tarball e instalador sin depender de CDN ni scripts inline.
